methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free AI workshops led by a Norfolk native represent grassroots knowledge distribution outside traditional tech hubs, signaling potential for peer-driven AI fluency in military-adjacent communities if sustained beyond individual initiatives.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU's institutional partnership with AI Ready RVA concentrates advanced AI education and innovation resources in the Richmond metro hub, deepening capability in the capital region but requiring explicit distribution mechanisms to reach beyond.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's WorkAI Lab focuses on preparing leaders for AI adoption rather than building technical depth, suggesting platform-layer readiness that could enable broad but shallow capability distribution in traditionally underserved regions.

signals.title: AI Has Already Arrived in Roanoke’s Classrooms. Here’s What Parents, Students, and Workers Should Know. - The Roanoke Rambler
signals.signal_reading: AI tools already deployed in Roanoke classrooms indicate consumer-grade platform adoption reaching beyond metro areas, but shallow integration focused on tool usage rather than deep technical understanding or local capability development.

signals.title: VT Science Corner: Designing better battery technology with X-rays and AI - Roanoke Times
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Tech researchers applying AI to battery technology demonstrates deep technical capability emerging in New River Valley academic institutions, creating potential knowledge transfer nodes outside NoVA if commercialization and workforce pathways connect to regional industry.
